items.text: Staff iOS Engineer with 8 years of experience architecting high-performance Swift and SwiftUI consumer applications, offline-first sync engines, and modular mobile platforms at scale.

entries.heading: Staff iOS Engineer | Wayfarer Air & Travel | 2021 – Present

items.text: Led the incremental migration of 45+ core booking and itinerary screens from legacy UIKit to declarative SwiftUI in Swift 5.9 for a 3.2M MAU flagship travel application.

Architected an offline-first persistence and background synchronization engine using GRDB (SQLite), BGTaskScheduler, and deterministic CRDT conflict resolution, enabling full itinerary edits in airplane mode.

Shaved cold start duration from 2.4s to 890ms and eliminated 60fps collection-view frame drops by diagnosing main-thread dyld stalls, zombie allocations, and runaway location polling with Time Profiler and Allocations traces.

Replaced nested DispatchQueue callback pyramids with Swift structured concurrency (async/await, custom Actor isolation, and TaskGroups) alongside Combine publishers, eliminating 94% of data-race crashes.

Orchestrated weekly TestFlight drops, dSYM symbolication, and 7-day staged App Store Connect rollouts (1% → 10% → 50% → 100%) gated by automated MetricKit and Crashlytics halt triggers across 3.2M monthly active users.
Decomposed a 420k-LOC monolithic Xcode project into 18 feature and core SPM modules with strict interface targets, cutting clean builds by 54% and incremental debug builds from 68s to 11s.
Authored 9 technical design proposals for client networking and deep-link navigation, ran biweekly code-review clinics, and coached 4 mid-level developers through promotions to Senior iOS Engineer.
Shipped real-time gate-change banners on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island alongside a wrist companion experience syncing QR boarding passes over Bluetooth to paired Apple Watches.
Implemented WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility support across the app, including Dynamic Type scaling, VoiceOver rotor actions, and reduced-motion transitions.

entries.heading: Senior iOS Engineer | Ridgemont Field Maps | 2018 – 2021

items.text: Designed a multi-context Core Data persistence layer with background NSManagedObjectContext batch imports to ingest 120k forestry waypoint records without blocking UI gestures.
Built breadcrumb trail recording with adaptive GPS geofencing and rendered 50,000+ offline topographic contour overlays at 60fps on iPad and iPhone.
Pinned TLS leaf certificates and migrated sensitive OAuth refresh tokens from NSUserDefaults into the hardware-backed iOS Keychain with biometric LAContext protection.
Built an internal feature-flag store kit and debug overlay menu for QA testers to toggle staging endpoints and inspect network payloads on physical test devices.
Combined three regional localization spreadsheets into an automated XLIFF string catalog pipeline supporting 11 European and Asian languages.
Developed custom AVFoundation audio playback queues with background lock-screen media controls and AirPlay routing for a long-form journalism app.
Wrote 180+ XCTest and XCUITest snapshot and UI automation tests executed nightly on a self-hosted Mac mini Jenkins node.
Migrated legacy Objective-C view controllers to Swift 4 with full nullability annotations and interoperability bridges.
Facilitated swift resolution of cross-team GraphQL and REST API contract disputes between mobile and backend squads.
Author of a command-line Swift tool that parses Package.swift manifests, detects circular dependency edges, and renders Graphviz module topology diagrams (410+ GitHub stars).
Published a GitHub Action that fails pull requests when feature modules import concrete implementation targets instead of interface protocols.
Designed brushed-metal skeuomorphic audio dials and CoreAudio polyphonic oscillator voices for an experimental iPad synthesizer toy.
